v26_field_authority.description: V26 authority migration profile. V26.1 establishes exact field-header ownership; V26.2 moves live Agent business semantics onto authority-bearing JudgementGraph, ActionGraph and OperationGraph without changing the sealed system Agent topology. The existing exact execution/hash runtime remains authoritative for transport identity. FACT and DERIVED remain system-owned; Agent1 owns judgement.*, Agent2 owns plan.*, Agent3 owns operation.* and dynamic operation_stage.*. Agent3 may reference registered plan fields but may not originate plan numbers. SystemStage remains Java/control-plane owned. Semantic business wording is opaque to authority validation.
